title: The Shopping List Read Aloud
youtube_title: The Shopping List Read Aloud | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who is tired is already a gentle skill.
summary: At a library return desk and the rainy steps, a shopping list written in a hurry, needing a second pair of eyes is awkward for one person. Gita notices Mr. Ade struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
